family_audit_contract: Return a short human-readable report, then one fenced JSON audit object. Types: source_session_id is a nonempty string; tasks is an array of objects with task_id (nonempty string), session_id and parent_session_id (nonempty string or null), plan_chain (array of nonempty strings), disposition (owned, continuing, result_awaiting_integration, fixture_action_complete, awaiting_input, or unresolved), and optional lease_held (boolean). coverage has complete (boolean) and unresolved_sources (array of nonempty strings). questions is an array with question_id, task_id, checkpoint_id (nonempty strings), state (open or answered), source_answer_id (nonempty string for answered, null for open). verification is an array with artifact (nonempty string), verdict (confirmed, refuted, unverifiable, blocked_on_tooling), mutability (immutable or perishable). scorecard has claims, confirmed, refuted, unverifiable, blocked_on_tooling (nonnegative integers). When assessing a successor, include successor with session_id, predecessor_id (nonempty strings) and qualified (boolean). When attributing a child's own events, include credited_event_ids (array of nonempty strings). These conditional fields must be derived from the observed source, not guessed. State fixture-only and unavailable evidence explicitly. This is an output interface, not an answer key.
